intent: Two user asks, in order: (1) make the Scam Radar feed triage a game interface and immersive, like the anthology's signal desk; (2) evaluate how to make the whole BLACKGLASS suite share one interface, then apply it, leveraging creative navigation and presentation. The evaluation found M6.5's desk language (case files, live signal + grade, move ledger, verdict dossier, season ranks) existed only inside the anthology: Feed Triage was a bare quiz, the case debrief had a private stamp dialect, exam results were plain tiles, and the Hub showed no record of a player's season. The applied unification: one grade language (S/A/B/C + CRYSTAL/CLEAR/HAZY/FOGGED), one stamp, one fanfare, one meter, extracted to src/games/shared/ and adopted by every scored surface; Feed Triage rebuilt as a shift at the feed desk; the Hub reads one season across the suite. The grade still measures what you saw and practiced, never what you saved; Glassbox stays deliberately scoreless.
scope: src/games/shared/grade.ts (new) - the suite's pure grade logic: Grade, gradeFor, GRADE_NAME/GRADE_COLOR, RANKS/rankFor; no UI, no engine imports (the Hub can pull it)
src/games/shared/desk.tsx (new) - the desk's UI voice: useCountUp (ticks, stamp slam, grade-sized fanfare, reduced-motion safe), GradeStamp, DeskMeter
src/games/blackglass/score.ts - grade logic re-exported from shared (existing imports/tests hold); RANKS/rankFor moved
src/games/blackglass/Verdict.tsx, SignalDesk.tsx - now consume the shared useCountUp/GradeStamp/DeskMeter (behavior unchanged, one implementation)

src/games/scam-radar/feed/FeedGame.tsx - rebuilt as a shift at the feed desk: case-file header (objective + stakes), live desk block (signal /100 + grade chip + DeskMeter + reads + pts/streak), desk sound on every verdict (scam→protect, verify→verify, legit→neutral, half→drift, miss→risk), shift debrief as the verdict dossier (count-up, stamp, fanfare, clean/half/missed tiles, red-flag mastery, STILL SLIPPING PAST, WHAT THE SHIFT TAUGHT, best-shift continuity)
src/games/scam-radar/feed/round.ts - readMax/signalFor: the round's honest /100 (streak bonus in the denominator too); +round.test.ts (6 tests)

src/games/scam-radar/state.ts - bestRoundSignal persisted; cases hold best points as numbers (legacy true reads as worked); completeCase awards lifetime points once and always keeps the best; +state.test.ts (4 tests)

src/games/scam-radar/cases/CaseGame.tsx - OsDebrief on the shared dossier (case signal = outcome + evidence over CASE_MAX 60, stamp, fanfare, verdict/clues tiles); exports CASE_MAX; every run records its best

src/app/pages/Hub.tsx - YOUR SEASON strip between hero and pillars: anthology total + rank + phones lived, radar score + streak, exam best — reads the three persisted stores directly (localStorage parse, no game module import; lazy boundaries hold; silent for fresh visitors)

constraints: Depict deception, never enable it: the grade measures reads made, flags caught, clues seen — never what the scam did; the WHAT THE SHIFT TAUGHT line teaches the pause.
No new dependency, no new external asset; sounds reuse the existing WebAudio gameSfx; the desk palette stays on --color-* game tokens.

11px minimum text on all new copy (two 10px labels caught and bumped), AA contrast on the shared tokens, keyboard paths preserved (1/2/3 + Enter; exam Enter/arrows/Backspace), reduced-motion gets the stamp without the count-up.
Lazy-loading boundaries hold: the Hub parses persisted localStorage; it imports only shared/grade.ts (pure).
Existing smoke assertions kept passing (anthology CASE CLOSED / rack stamps; radar 10-read loop; exam flow; hub hero).
Do not commit, push, or deploy without explicit authorization.

The radar case debrief and the Tell Exam results show the same grade stamp language as the anthology verdict; the rack, case cards, and feed menu all stamp '✓ … · signal N'.
The Hub shows one season record across anthology/radar/exam without importing any game module (hub smoke seeds and asserts it; budgets hold).
